answers.question: How do I create a group conversation in Messaging?
answers.publicWorkflowAnswer: To create a group conversation in Messaging: 1. Open Messaging from the app header. 2. Choose New group. 3. Enter a group name. 4. Select at least one other participant. 5. Choose Create group. Only the creator can rename the group or add/remove participants. Current members share the full history; removed members lose access. Previously signed attachment links may remain usable for up to ten minutes.
